source: EPA NVFEL benchmark test-data package, workbook '4- 2013 Ford 1.6L EcoBoost Engine LEV III Fuel - Test Data.xlsx' (package directory 2013-ford-1.6l-ecoboost-engine-lev-lev-3-fuel-test-data-package-10-25-18); public data, https://www.epa.gov/vehicle-and-fuel-emissions-testing/ (urls in out/epa_turbo_dl/urls.txt). Literal workbook readings rounded to 6 significant digits; nothing derived except the normalised cam signs, the two-bank lambda mean and the envelope / high_load flags.
selection: light load: map_kpa <= 60.0, 0.95 <= lambda <= 1.05, bmep_bar >= 0.3 (no-knock check: true knock limit >= measured spark)

cam_convention.normalised: intake_cam_adv_deg positive = advanced; exhaust_cam_ret_deg positive = retarded
